SMTO-WEB-0004 — The search server is reachable but won't send results to SMTO

GUID: bb44b596-1de2-4df3-8cee-62daf2211981
Slug: web-provider-json-api-unavailable
Domain: WEB · Subsystem: web

What happened

  • SMTO reached your search server, but the server says the results format SMTO needs is switched off. No search results came back.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask the person who runs your SearXNG search server to allow the machine-readable results format in its search format settings, then restart that server. SMTO can only read SearXNG results in that format, and the server says it is turned off.
  2. Then open Settings › Setup › Capabilities, select Configure Web, and select Test connection for that provider. The test sends one small search and confirms the server now returns results SMTO can read.
  3. Until it's fixed, choose another enabled provider such as DuckDuckGo as Default provider, or set Fallback search to Also when the default provider fails, then select Save. Other providers don't depend on this server setting.

What success looks like

  • Test connection shows Connected, and a new web search in a conversation returns results.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who runs the search server. This only affects that one search server; reading public web pages and other search providers can still work.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The SearXNG instance answered HTTP 403 or 406 with text stating that JSON output is disabled, unavailable or unsupported.

What this means

  • Search receives HTTP 403 or 406 and response text explicitly describes JSON output as disabled, unavailable or unsupported. The diagnostic adds no retrieval. Read outcomes and retained receipts determine what evidence is available; an error does not establish the content of an unread source.

Why this can happen

  • Search receives HTTP 403 or 406 and response text explicitly describes JSON output as disabled, unavailable or unsupported.

How to diagnose it

  • Confirm the selected instance and its configured output formats using the recorded response.

How to fix it

  • Enable JSON output on the SearXNG instance (add json to search.formats in its settings.yml and restart it), then run Test connection from the Web Skill configuration. Other providers and Web Read are unaffected; see SearXNGProvider.search in src/agent_runtime/skills/web/providers.py.
  • Configure a supported provider API mode or use a currently supported fallback.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • That same provider returns supported JSON search results after its configuration is corrected.

What not to do

  • Do not treat an unavailable JSON response format as proof that all Web access is unavailable.

Technical notes

  • The diagnostic adds no retrieval. Read outcomes and retained receipts determine what evidence is available; an error does not establish the content of an unread source.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
